security.title: Apache Struts vulnerable to memory exhaustion
security.description:
[CVE-2023-34396](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4g42-gqrg-4633): Apache Struts vulnerable to memory exhaustion

Severity: HIGH

Affected dependencies:
  - org.apache.struts:struts-core:1.3.10 (declared at build.gradle:18), vulnerable range `<= 1.3.10`

Recommended fix: upgrade from Struts 1.x to a supported framework/version because no patched Struts 1 version is provided.

security.title: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context
security.description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.

evidence.explanation: Static formatter instances (DecimalFormat/SimpleDateFormat) are shared across requests in Struts Action singletons without synchronization. These mutable classes are not thread-safe and are used concurrently in execute/readHistory paths.

security.title: Missing Synchronization
security.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner but does not attempt to synchronize access to the resource.

evidence.explanation: Static formatter instances (DecimalFormat/SimpleDateFormat) are shared across requests in Struts Action singletons without synchronization. These mutable classes are not thread-safe and are used concurrently in execute/readHistory paths.

security.title: Use of Hard-coded Password
security.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

evidence.explanation: Configuration file contains hard-coded database password `db.****** in paygateway.properties line 5, which is used for outbound database authentication via PayGatewayConfig.getDbPassword().

security.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
security.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.

evidence.explanation: Configuration contains hard-coded database credentials (`db.user=sa`, `db.****** used by PayGatewayConfig and PayGatewayConnectionFactory for database authentication.

security.title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
security.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

evidence.explanation: JSP scriptlets render request attributes directly using <%= ... %> without output encoding. In payment.jsp line 12, username is output directly; in login.jsp line 23, loginError is output directly. User/attribute values flowing into these attributes can execute script content in the browser.
